== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Independent [[Guilds]] are a collection of powerful organizations that serve as essential pillars for the [[Aurelian Empire]]. Comprising the [[Alchemists]], [[Consultants]], [[Greenwardens]], and the [[Luminian Order]], these groups hold significant economic influence that rivals the military strength of the Imperialist factions. While they provide vital support services necessary for the empire's continued functioning, their internal cooperation has faltered due to infighting. The [[Consultants]] are noted for their extreme efficiency and reliability, often acting as a Shadow{{!}}shadow security force, while the [[Luminian Order]] provides overt protection. Some guilds, such as the [[Consultants]], are known to employ assassins or specialized groups like the [[Gardeners]] to eliminate threats. Historically, these guilds have been bound by the Authority{{!}}authority of the Emperor; without his leadership, there are concerns they may lose their moral direction and become mere mercenaries driven by profit. Furthermore, the dissolution of other groups, such as the [[Champions]], has contributed to a shifting landscape where regional governors seek to establish their own versions of these influential entities.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regents]] expressed a desire for the Independent [[Guilds]] to voluntarily speak with a single voice. Despite this goal, the guilds remained unpopular within the heart of The Empire{{!}}the Empire. The responsibility for establishing mutual defense or unification efforts rested solely upon these guilds. Following their eventual retreat, the Independent [[Guilds]] were responsible for the death of [[Baldezar Kern]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regents]] want the [[Independent Guilds]] to speak with one voice voluntarily.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Independent Guilds]] are not loved in the heart of The Empire{{!}}the Empire.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The burden of making unification or mutual defense efforts falls on the [[Independent Guilds]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Independent Guilds]] have already retreated.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Independent Guilds]] killed [[Baldezar Kern]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c12">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
